concept.title: My Review Tasks Page and Review Task Header
concept.shortdesc: This topic explains how to use the My Review Tasks page to find and open review tasks and describes the information and actions available in the review task header.

section.title: My Review Tasks page
section.p: When you navigate to Review Tasks, the My Review Tasks page opens in the main area. It shows tasks that you own and tasks assigned to you.
section.note: You can return to the My Review Tasks page in several ways. For example, click the Oxygen Content Fusion logo, click Review Tasks in the left stripe from the main Projects page, click My Review Tasks in the top stripe, click the Home button in the top stripe, or use the breadcrumb when a page inside a review task is open.
section.p: Filters and task list
The page includes filters that help you focus on the tasks you need.

ul.li: All my tasks shows all tasks that you own and all tasks that are assigned to you.
Owned By Me shows only the tasks where you are an owner.
Assigned To Me shows only the tasks that are assigned to you for review.

section.p: When you are in the Assigned To Me tab, you can click Show finalized to include tasks that you already finalized.
You can use the Filter by name field to filter the list of review tasks and find a specific task more quickly.
The task list includes columns for the task Name, Project and Branch for project review tasks, Owners, Review Status, Due Date when one is configured in the Task Settings page, and Last Access.
To open a task, click it in the list. This opens the Task Files page.

The task review status is displayed in the list. A new task is shown as In review until a task owner closes the review. After that, the status is shown as Review closed. For more information about review status and how it relates to the task state, see Review Task States and Status.
Task actions for owners
For tasks in the Owned By Me tab, you can hover over a task to display an actions menu on the far right side. This menu includes the following actions.

ul.li: Mark as integrated - Available when the task is in the Review closed state. This archives the task and removes it from visibility for all users.

section.p: To create a new task or add files from the browser interface, see Creating Tasks and Files from the Browser Interface.

section.title: Review task header
section.p: When a review task is open, the upper part of the header stripe remains available no matter which page you open inside the task. This keeps the main navigation options and the breadcrumb available at all times.

fig.title: Review Task Header Stripe (Independent Review Task)

section.p: Header details and actions

The lower part of the header changes depending on the page context and your role in the task. It can show the task title, the review status, the task owners, the number of reviewers who have finalized the task, and the due date, if a due date is configured in the Task Settings page. You can click More Details to see additional information such as the creation time and the current branch for project review tasks.
If you are a task owner, you can click Share to configure access to the task.
You can click the Owners area to see information about the task owners.
You can click the Finalized widget to see the status for each assigned reviewer.
Re-review and changed files

If a task owner clicks the Finalized widget for a task where reviewers have finalized their review, the task owner can use the Request re-review button. This resets the finalized status for all reviewers and changes their status to In progress. If the task owner reopens a closed task, the finalized status is also reset for all reviewers.

Users who are assigned to the task but have not yet accessed it are labeled as Pending in the Review Status Summary pop-up window. This helps task owners identify users who have not yet responded to the review request.

When a reviewer opens a task after the owner requested another review, the Task Files page includes a Changed files only filter. This makes it easier to identify the files that changed and need another review.
